mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.2% in a month, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market that contracts consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output signal an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer confidence and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market slack (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening employment conditions that reduce consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both UNRATE and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.
